title: Choose the visual world
question: Which clean direction should shape the PHP-Investment landing page?

options.label: Registered Correspondence
options.lineage: precise European business correspondence and archival letterhead
options.thesis: The landing page becomes one impeccably composed piece of correspondence, ready to be answered.
options.viewport: A full-height letter sheet carries the company name, one large general statement, and an unmistakable reply line for email contact.
options.risk: It can feel overly formal if the typography lacks warmth and scale.

raised.raise: Repeated alignment marks give the page a disciplined horizontal rhythm.
The first viewport commits to one dominant field instead of collecting small corporate modules.
Subtle material variation keeps the paper world human rather than sterile.
Information arrives in clearly registered layers while the key structure remains fixed.
The company mark stays immutable while restrained accent details identify active links.

options.label: Swiss Stewardship Report
options.lineage: Swiss annual reports and modernist corporate identity programmes
options.thesis: A rigorous editorial grid makes a deliberately general company feel clear, credible, and contemporary.
options.viewport: A strong typographic statement spans an asymmetrical grid, with company facts and direct email access held in a slim information rail.
options.risk: This is the most familiar high-craft direction for a restrained investment company.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.lineage: architectural daylight sections and material studies
options.thesis: Long-term perspective is expressed as a calm architectural section shaped by a moving band of light.
options.viewport: The company statement occupies a luminous open room while navigation, address, and contact sit like precise section annotations.
options.case: It gives long-term stewardship a memorable physical form, though the metaphor is less immediately direct than correspondence.
options.risk: The architectural language may imply a sector focus the company has not claimed.

options.label: Measured Signals
options.thesis: Company facts repeat as calibrated channels across one measured field.
options.viewport: A sweep of aligned information channels leads to contact.
options.case: The calibration metaphor is vivid but suggests performance data the page cannot honestly provide.
options.risk: It could imply financial monitoring or quantified results.
options.kept: Its disciplined repetition strengthens the correspondence grid.

options.label: Living Field
options.thesis: A single living color field carries the entire introduction.
options.viewport: Thin company information floats over a slowly changing field.
options.case: It is memorable but conflicts with the no-production-JavaScript constraint and overstates the page's experience.
options.risk: The effect would become the product.
options.kept: Its total first-viewport commitment raises the chosen direction.

options.label: Material Sequence
options.thesis: The company introduction unfolds as a tactile sequence of frames.
options.viewport: A restrained frame sequence carries statement, purpose, and contact.
options.case: Its sense of time suits long-term thinking, but the cinematic treatment weakens corporate clarity.
options.risk: Texture could read as nostalgia rather than permanence.
options.kept: Its human material variation prevents sterile minimalism.

options.label: Registered Layers
options.thesis: The page resolves one informational layer at a time against a fixed key structure.
options.viewport: Company statement and contact build in precise printed layers.
options.case: The layered logic is useful, but the cultural form has no authentic connection to the company.
options.risk: It would feel adopted for style alone.
options.kept: Its fixed key structure sharpens the chosen hierarchy.

options.label: Institutional Kit
options.thesis: A fixed crest and changing context labels organize the company identity.
options.viewport: The company mark anchors a bold field with contact details treated as context patches.
options.case: Its identity discipline is strong, but the sporting affiliation would be arbitrary.
options.risk: It can read as sponsorship or merchandise.
options.kept: Its immutable-mark discipline strengthens brand consistency.

canonCard.label: Quiet Investment Standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional premium corporate landing page, executed with restraint and precision.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline, short company summary, discreet abstract image, and clear contact button.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately legible but intentionally difficult to distinguish from peers.
